name: 3884-mixedprefill-13b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, sm90, one GPU.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate = 8 req/s, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10% by completed requests, bounded at 2000 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no tools, every request the same shape: 550 prompt tokens, 150 output tokens, both pinned min=max. `request_format: plain` because this is a base checkpoint with no chat template. Greedy (temperature 0.0), seed 3853. The backend forces ignore_eos whenever max_tokens is set, so every request emits exactly 150 tokens.
purpose: A text completion service on a 13-billion-parameter model handling steady 8-per-second uniform short prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# April-2024 vLLM. These keys are `AsyncEngineArgs` fields -- `vllm serve --config` does not
# exist at this version, and an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, so do not
# carry keys over from a later vLLM.

model: NousResearch/Llama-2-13b-hf
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
